name: Media Player (Sauce Edition)
description: Plays nearly any video, music file or stream, using the same playback engine as VLC, with a simple, friendly window. Playlists, subtitles, an equalizer, picture controls, full screen, carry on where you left off, convert files, and YouTube, Netflix and Prime Video in their own window.
requirements: Nothing else to install: everything it needs comes in the download

credits.asset: libVLC 3.0 (VLC's playback engine) and its plugins
credits.author: VideoLAN and the VLC authors

credits.asset: .NET runtime and WPF (bundled with the app)
credits.author: .NET Foundation and Contributors
